newsitem.title: DENMARK: Clinton arrives in Denmark, staying until Saturday.
newsitem.headline: Clinton arrives in Denmark, staying until Saturday.

text.p: Bill Clinton arrived in Denmark on Friday on the first visit to a Scandinavian country by a serving U.S. president.
Clinton arrived aboard Air Force One at 9.35 p.m.(1935 GMT) at Copenhagen airport from the Romanian capital, Bucharest.

He is to stay overnight at Danish Queen Margrethe's summer palace, 30 km (20 miles) north of the capital, and address the Danish people at an open air rally in central Copenhagen at 3.30 p.m. (1330 GMT) on Saturday before returning to Washington.
